definition: Queries asking how to manage a condition, choose treatment, sequence care, or select a first-line intervention.
inclusion_signals: management; treatment algorithm; first line; treatment choice; escalation
exclusion_signals: questions centered on drug dose, safety, interaction, or test selection
source: Monsalve et al. (2026), Clinical Information Needs Among Latin American Physicians: A Multi-Country Analysis of Semantic Clinical Search, medRxiv, https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.06.26.26356340

definition: Queries asking which diagnosis explains observed symptoms or how to distinguish plausible diagnoses.
inclusion_signals: possible diagnosis; differential; cause of symptoms; distinguish diseases
exclusion_signals: management of an already named diagnosis; risk scoring
source: Monsalve et al. (2026), Clinical Information Needs Among Latin American Physicians: A Multi-Country Analysis of Semantic Clinical Search, medRxiv, https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.06.26.26356340

definition: Queries asking which diagnostic test, imaging study, laboratory test, or investigation should be ordered next.
inclusion_signals: which test; imaging choice; laboratory selection; work-up
exclusion_signals: interpretation of a result already available
source: Monsalve et al. (2026), Clinical Information Needs Among Latin American Physicians: A Multi-Country Analysis of Semantic Clinical Search, medRxiv, https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.06.26.26356340

definition: Queries asking what an existing laboratory, imaging, ECG, pathology, or other clinical result means.
inclusion_signals: interpret result; abnormal value; what does this finding mean
source: Monsalve et al. (2026), Clinical Information Needs Among Latin American Physicians: A Multi-Country Analysis of Semantic Clinical Search, medRxiv, https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.06.26.26356340; informed by the metric/interpretation distinction in Liang et al. (2025), A hybrid model integrating RoBERTa, TF-IDF, and attention mechanism for medical query intent classification, Scientific Reports, https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-025-25783-x

definition: Drug-centered queries about medication choice, dosing, safety, efficacy, interactions, administration, comparison, or monitoring.
inclusion_signals: drug name/class; dose; safety; adverse effect; interaction; efficacy; comparison
exclusion_signals: non-drug management or general disease background
source: Monsalve et al. (2026), Clinical Information Needs Among Latin American Physicians: A Multi-Country Analysis of Semantic Clinical Search, medRxiv, https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.06.26.26356340; finer boundaries informed by therapy, caution, and effect in Liang et al. (2025), A hybrid model integrating RoBERTa, TF-IDF, and attention mechanism for medical query intent classification, Scientific Reports, https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-025-25783-x

definition: Queries seeking a guideline, recommendation, current evidence, trial, or date-specific clinical update.
inclusion_signals: guideline; latest; update; evidence; trial; year constraint
exclusion_signals: a treatment decision without an explicit evidence request
source: Monsalve et al. (2026), Clinical Information Needs Among Latin American Physicians: A Multi-Country Analysis of Semantic Clinical Search, medRxiv, https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.06.26.26356340

definition: Queries asking how to perform a clinical procedure, intervention, or bedside technique.
inclusion_signals: procedure steps; technique; how to perform; operative approach
source: Monsalve et al. (2026), Clinical Information Needs Among Latin American Physicians: A Multi-Country Analysis of Semantic Clinical Search, medRxiv, https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.06.26.26356340

definition: Queries asking about frequency, risk, natural history, expected outcomes, or prognosis of a condition or treatment.
inclusion_signals: incidence; prevalence; prognosis; risk; long-term outcome
exclusion_signals: drug efficacy in a named trial or immediate monitoring
source: Monsalve et al. (2026), Clinical Information Needs Among Latin American Physicians: A Multi-Country Analysis of Semantic Clinical Search, medRxiv, https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.06.26.26356340; outcome/prognosis boundary informed by Liang et al. (2025), A hybrid model integrating RoBERTa, TF-IDF, and attention mechanism for medical query intent classification, Scientific Reports, https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-025-25783-x

definition: Queries asking how to explain a condition, result, treatment, or risk to a patient or caregiver.
inclusion_signals: explain to patient; counseling; patient handout; shared decision
source: Monsalve et al. (2026), Clinical Information Needs Among Latin American Physicians: A Multi-Country Analysis of Semantic Clinical Search, medRxiv, https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.06.26.26356340

definition: Queries whose information need is unclear, genuinely multi-intent without a primary need, or unsupported by the operational taxonomy.
inclusion_signals: underspecified; no reproducible boundary; conflicting primary needs
exclusion_signals: a query with a clear supported information need
source: Monsalve et al. (2026), Clinical Information Needs Among Latin American Physicians: A Multi-Country Analysis of Semantic Clinical Search, medRxiv, https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.06.26.26356340; other-category ambiguity considerations informed by Liang et al. (2025), A hybrid model integrating RoBERTa, TF-IDF, and attention mechanism for medical query intent classification, Scientific Reports, https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-025-25783-x
